hero.lead: I build products end to end —**frontend, backend and mobile**— with a focus on clean code, accessibility and shipping value fast. A versatile, low-risk junior.

about.title: The player card
about.name: Miquel Roca
about.h: The product midfielder: I link the backend defence with the frontend attack.
about.p1: I started in the **frontend** and worked my way down to the server until I was comfortable across the whole pitch. Today I design APIs, model data and polish accessible interfaces without losing sight of the business.
about.p2: Away from the keyboard: football on Sundays, arthouse cinema midweek and a notebook full of half-finished ideas. **I learn fast and play for the team.**

lineSub.def: The foundation everything is built on.
lineSub.fwd: What the user sees and touches.

e1.b1: Automated **carrier, pallet and package assignment** on Odoo outgoing orders with `Python` (server actions and crons). In production.
e1.b2: Built **automatic shipment confirmation** on marketplaces (Mirakl, Lengow, PrestaShop) using webhooks, `REST APIs` and `XML-RPC`.
e1.b3: Set up **Docker test environments** (Odoo 17 + PostgreSQL) with API doubles to test without touching production.

e2.b1: Built **data extraction and structuring** systems (web scraping) with `Python` to feed market analysis.
e2.b2: Automated information gathering with `n8n` and `Python`, removing repetitive manual work.
e2.b3: Designed **custom software tools** for market analysis, containerised with `Docker`.

flag.title: Tenly
flag.tagline: Tennis predictions powered by machine learning, in your pocket.
flag.problem: Tennis fans had no simple way to check matches, stats and data-driven predictions from a single app.
flag.solution: Built a cross-platform app with Expo and React Native connected to an ML-powered API, with data charts and Supabase auth.
flag.role: Full-stack — from the data model and API to the interface and deploy on Vercel + Railway.
flag.result: Working app shipped with real-time predictions, interactive charts and web + mobile support from a single codebase.
